# 行舟 · 个人项目与事务中心 v0.2.0

这一版本重新整理了工作项详情页的信息架构。长期领域、顶层项目、子项目、任务、事务和想法不再共用一套容易造成困惑的字段，而是只显示当前角色真正需要维护的内容。

## 主要更新

- 详情页改为角色感知布局：长期领域隐藏执行层字段；项目和任务保留层级、状态与真实期限；事务和想法提供计划日期、预计时长与所需精力。
- “所属顶层项目”根据直接父项链自动推导并只读显示；明确修改父项时会同步更新推导结果。
- 截止日期升级为三态：`待确认`、`无`、`具体日期`。新增属性视图复选框字段“无截止日期”，避免以后分不清是忘记填写还是确实没有期限。
- 整理页会提醒尚未确认截止日期的适用工作项，但不会反复提醒已经明确选择“无”的条目。
- 工作项右键菜单改用思源原生菜单组件，更贴合思源主题、暗黑模式和既有交互风格。

## 数据库说明

使用三态截止日期前，请确保目标属性视图包含名为“无截止日期”的复选框字段。插件不会擅自迁移或重建数据库。

## 下载

请下载本 Release 附件中的 `package.zip`。不要使用 GitHub 自动生成的 Source code 压缩包作为思源插件包。

完整记录见 [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Yong2Sheng/siyuan-plugin-xingzhou/blob/v0.2.0/CHANGELOG.md)。

# Xingzhou · Personal Projects & Tasks v0.2.0

This release reorganizes the work-item detail experience. Long-term areas, top-level projects, subprojects, tasks, transactions, and ideas no longer share one confusing set of fields; each role now exposes only the information it actually needs.

## Highlights

- Added role-aware detail layouts: areas hide execution-only fields; projects and tasks retain hierarchy, status, and real deadlines; transactions and ideas expose planning date, duration, and energy.
- Derived the top project from the direct-parent chain and displayed it read-only, while explicit parent changes update the derived value.
- Upgraded deadlines to three states: `Pending`, `None`, or a `Concrete date`. The new “无截止日期” checkbox distinguishes an explicit no-deadline decision from a forgotten blank.
- Review now flags applicable items whose deadlines are still unconfirmed, while skipping items explicitly marked as deadline-free.
- Replaced the custom work-item context menu with SiYuan's native menu for consistent theme, dark-mode, and interaction behavior.

## Database note

Before using three-state deadlines, ensure that the target Attribute View contains a checkbox field named “无截止日期”. Xingzhou does not silently migrate or rebuild the database schema.

## Download

Download the attached `package.zip`. Do not use GitHub's automatically generated source-code archives as the SiYuan plugin package.

See [CHANGELOG.en.md](https://github.com/Yong2Sheng/siyuan-plugin-xingzhou/blob/v0.2.0/CHANGELOG.en.md) for the complete record.
